todos: [P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: qwen3.8:27b full-task qualification remains open. A new full live run must confirm qualification; a smaller context or faster host may still help throughput. Snapshots: %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\*tracker-20260927* and *closure-20260927*.
